# Freerouting SES interoperability fixture

`freerouting_issue368_no_gui_v2_3_0.ses` is copied from Freerouting's public
`fixtures/Issue368-CorneyIslandWireless/corney_island_wireless (no-GUI).ses`
at tag `v2.3.0`. It is retained as an external syntax corpus so Copperpour's SES
reader is tested against output owned by Freerouting rather than only synthetic
Copperpour fixtures.

Source: <https://github.com/freerouting/freerouting/blob/v2.3.0/fixtures/Issue368-CorneyIslandWireless/corney_island_wireless%20(no-GUI).ses>
